test_title: PYST 36: SSC CHSL 2024 - Reasoning (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
What would be the letter on the opposite side of ‘P’ if the given sheet is folded to form a cube? 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/183ae91dc005732c6f475a8781d3da64dd0f571e4d5c11281840d2b7939d3ef6.png]
solution:
The faces opposite to each other are shown below:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/551572aa45d9e3aaee2ce275ea7ee2875740a0bf19a2a46f5c5510dc9aa562e7.png] 

⇒ As the alternate positions become opposite to each other, the remaining two faces become opposite to each other.

So, opposite pairs are:

L → K

N → P

O → M

Therefore, 'N' is the opposite of 'P'.

Hence, "N" is the correct answer.
